description:
Our project, *Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer*, is an interactive learning platform designed to introduce students to space, planets, rockets, and astronaut life. It provides fun missions, quizzes, and challenges to improve scientific knowledge and creativity.

**Our Team Goal:**
To make learning about space fun, interesting, and easy for everyone while inspiring young minds to explore the universe.

**Join Our Team and Explore the Universe! 🌎🚀**
summary:
This project uses Artificial Intelligence (AI) and wireless communication to control a simulated butterfly. The butterfly movements are processed by an AI chip, which sends signals to the transmitter and receiver (TX & RX).

The received signals are used to control the motor and battery system. The main aim is to demonstrate AI-based signal processing and wireless control.

Main Components:

* Simulated Butterfly

* Signal Generator

* AI Chip

* Transmitter and Receiver

* Wireless Coil System

* Battery and Motor

Working:

* The butterfly movement is simulated.

* The AI chip processes the input signals.

* The transmitter sends signals wirelessly.

* The receiver receives the signals.

* The battery and motor section represents the output control system.

Applications:

* AI-based automation

* Wireless communication

* Smart control systems

* Robotics and simulation

Conclusion: This project demonstrates how AI and wireless technology can work together to process signals and control a system.
